api_plan.product: No new public product interface initially: retain RangeConfig/RangeKind/ContextState/ProbeResult and existing single-owner ProbeWait; parent integrates config/dhcp.rs and daemon/main edits separately. Failed remains for cancellation/entropy/owner failures; only actual ICMP network failures are aligned with C after observations.
api_plan.tool: One family driver with packet helpers, raw DHCP/BOOTP/relay port capture, child-only seccomp syscall faults, ICMP capture, timed cache witnesses and concurrent DNS/TFTP during a pending DHCP exchange.

boundaries.requirement: SDBM hardware/extended-client identity seed and inclusive bounds determine free offer; OFFER does not commit. One-address exhaustion/reuse stays bounded.
Configured host and existing client lease precede generic allocation; requested free address is considered only inside eligible dynamic range and does not override reserved/router/in-use addresses.
Static ranges do not allocate unknown clients; configured hosts on subnet can be outside dynamic bounds. Narrowing prefers available dynamic, then static on subnet, then other nonproxy context.
BOOTP configured host/static-range path works; dynamic BOOTP permission does not convert static/proxy range into allocator. Reuse existing PXE/BOOTP packet helper.
Proxy ranges do not lease; matching PXE discovery receives proxy response, ordinary clients remain unanswered; tagged/mixed proxy/dynamic head behavior follows C.
Allocator excludes all contexts router addresses, existing leases, configured static reservations and ClassC .0/.255; equivalent ClassA/B low octets are not blanket rejected.
Pool wrap/exhaustion and DECLINE epoch perturbation are bounded; RELEASE frees lease; no address leaks across contexts. Sequential option regression is interaction only, not a second option close.
